items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex cracks 500 pts, Nifty near 22,700; IT, FMCG top sectoral laggards
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Wednesday: Benchmark indices traded in negative territory on Oct 28. Sensex and Nifty 50 both plunged 1 per cent intraday.

items.title: HUL trades on a volatile note post Q2 results; stock near 6-year low
items.description: Hindustan Unilever share price swung in a range of 5% after the company reported 4% growth in Q2 consolidated net profit.

items.title: Tata Capital shares jump 5% post Q2 show; analysts say margin revival key
items.description: MOFSL said that the outlook remains favourable for Tata Capital as current valuations adequately reflect the company's near-term growth and earnings potential.

items.title: You can't regulate your own thing: Sebi chief on exchange self-listing
items.description: Speaking at the Business Standard BFSI Insight Summit 2026, Sebi chief Tuhin Kanta Pandey said exchange self-listing raises regulatory concerns over who regulates an exchange's own shares

items.title: Nifty IT index slips 4%; Infosys, TCS, Coforge tank up to 5%; here's why
items.description: Till Tuesday in October 2026, the Nifty IT index outperformed the market and rallied 12%, compared to 0.05% decline in the Nifty 50.

items.title: Jio Platforms lists at 21% premium, becomes India's 2nd-most valuable firm
items.description: Jio Platforms' ₹30,213 crore IPO was fully subscribed within 100 minutes of opening on October 21. The issue was booked 22.19 times, with strong institutional demand driving the bids.

items.title: Market fall explained: Sensex dives 995 points intraday, Nifty at 22,500
items.description: VK Vijayakumar of Geojit Investments said that market has turned decisively weak amid reports of possible renewed strikes by the US on Iran after the midterm elections in the US.

items.title: Piramal Pharma soars 15% in weak market on huge volume post Q2 results
items.description: With H2 typically stronger than H1, Piramal Pharma's management said it is well-positioned to deliver a strong FY performance, supported by healthy order book and encouraging customer engagement.

items.title: United Breweries surges 15% as premiumisation drives Q2 PAT higher by 190%
items.description: United Breweries witnessed a 480 bps margin expansion to 11.9 per cent, reflecting strong operating leverage and disciplined cost management.

items.title: L&T surges 6%, sees sharpest intraday rally in 6 months on strong Q2 show
items.description: L&T delivered healthy revenue growth and record order inflows, with the ₹8.5 trillion order book at the end of September quarter providing robust multi-year revenue visibility.

items.title: Nifty F&O rollovers flag 'Neutral' bias; IT, telecom positive: Analysts
items.description: Nifty rollover to the November series was below its three-month average, and the cost of carry also declined, said Dharmesh Bhatt of Systematix Institutional Research.

items.title: Maruti dips marginally post Q2 amid cost pressures; analysts remain bullish
items.description: While concerns around margin trajectory remain, analysts largely retained a positive outlook over the medium term, driven by strong domestic demand and balance sheet strength.

items.title: Carlsberg India files updated IPO prospectus for 86.42 million shares
items.description: This is the first public IPO ‌prospectus from Carlsberg India, which had confidentially filed papers for the planned offering in July

items.title: BSE, Lenskart: Motilal Oswal stock ideas across large-, mid- and small-caps
items.description: Analysts at Motilal Oswal Wealth Management Research Desk are bullish on mid-caps Indian Hotels and Lenskart, and small-caps Symbiotec Pharmalab and Urban Company.

items.title: Stocks to watch: Jio Platforms, HUL, Adani Enterprises, Maruti Suzuki, L&T
items.description: Stocks to watch today: Jio Platforms' $3.1 billion India-record initial public offering is set to debut on Dalal Street today.

items.title: Bharti Airtel, MCX, Laurus Labs look bullish on charts: Chandan Taparia
items.description: Stocks to buy: MCX has formed a bullish candle, reclaimed the 50-DEMA and started making higher highs, indicating renewed buying interest, explains Chandan Taparia of Motilal Oswal.

items.title: Vinay Rajani expects Nifty to rally above 22,800; shares 2 stock ideas
items.description: Vinay Rajani of HDFC Securities believes that a sustained move above 22,800 could clear the 20-DEMA resistance and open the way for Nifty toward the next resistance at 23,175.

items.title: Derivatives trading may need more guardrails, says Sebi WTM Murty
items.description: At the BFSI Insight Summit 2026, Sebi's KVR Murty said retail derivatives trading may need more guardrails amid expiry-day hyperactivity, stressing investor protection and market integrity.

items.title: SAT sets aside ₹1.49 crore MCX penalty on Ventura over invalid order
items.description: The tribunal has ordered MCX to refund Rs 1.76 crore to Ventura Securities after finding that a former committee member had signed the penalty order over a position-limit breach

items.title: Jio Platforms IPO surge ends Tata's reign as India's most valuable group
items.description: Jio Platforms' shares surged as much as 23% on debut, pushing Reliance Group's market value past ₹30 trillion and overtaking Tata Group as India's most valuable conglomerate.

items.title: India not yet a consensus buy amid oil, tech disruptions: Global brokerages
items.description: India is yet to emerge as a consensus buy for foreign investors, with relative growth prospects, elevated oil prices and uncertain IT earnings weighing on inflows.

items.title: Stock tips, mis-selling: Sanjay Kathuria flags key investment traps
items.description: Sanjay Kathuria said that investors should examine the costs and conditions of financial products before committing their money. The mindset should be to ask questions.

items.title: Expansion, sourcing gains ahead for JSW Steel as capacity and volumes rise
items.description: JSW Steel plans to expand capacity to 78 million tonnes by FY32, backed by raw material integration, stronger volumes and internal cash flows, though coking coal costs remain a concern.

items.title: Value investing still works, but stock selection is key: Fund managers
items.description: Business Standard BFSI Summit: Mutual fund leaders say investors must look beyond market narratives and assess businesses on their fundamentals and valuations

items.title: Brent holds atop $110 as geopolitical risk overrides easing physical stress
items.description: The key shift in October is that the oil price rally has changed character from reflecting genuine physical tightness to what could happen next, explains Kaynat Chainwala of Kotak Neo.

items.title: Deven Choksey's IPO playbook: Spot valuations, read DRHPs, assess risks
items.description: At the Smart Arena segment of the Business Standard BFSI Insight Summit 2026, Deven Choksey advised retail investors to check an IPO's size, business model, financials & risk factors before investing

items.title: Sona Comstar zooms 101% from January low; hits new high in weak market
items.description: Sona BLW Precision share price: The stock price of the auto ancillary company quoted higher for the third straight day, surging 17 per cent during the period.

items.title: Roll out red carpet for dollar, make capital gains tax zero: Shankar Sharma
items.description: Shankar Sharma has called for lower taxes on fixed-income investments to incentivise them over equity investments.

items.title: Dabba to demat: Rachana Ranade on women's road to financial independence
items.description: Highlighting how women have long saved money in 'dabbas', Rachana Ranade noted "the only thing is to convert those savings from that dabba to a demat."

items.title: Investor education must explain why beating benchmarks is tough: Experts
items.description: Speaking at the Business Standard BFSI Insight Summit 2026, panellists said investor education must explain why beating market benchmarks consistently is difficult, beyond costs and tracking error

items.title: HDFC Bank, ITC, HDFC Life, Nestle, Britannia, TaMo PV hit 52-week lows
items.description: Colgate Palmolive, M&M Financial Services, Mazagaon Dock, Max Financial, SBI Card, Voltas and Waaree Energies from BSE 200 index also registered 52-week lows on Wednesday.

items.title: Datanomics: Jio breaks decade-long trend of record IPOs listing at discount
items.description: io Platforms' 21% listing gain bucks a trend of weak debuts by India's biggest IPOs as the issue sets a new fundraising record

items.title: BFSI Insight Summit: SIFs, new PMS rules to democratise wealth management
items.description: At the BFSI Insight Summit 2026, fund managers said SIFs and new PMS rules could widen access to wealth management, supported by rising household wealth and digital distribution

items.description: Fund managers at the Business Standard BFSI Insight Summit 2026 stressed selective stock-picking, reasonable valuations and business fundamentals amid divergent market trends.

items.title: BFSI Insight Summit 2026: 'Lower taxes may bring back foreign investors'
items.description: At the BFSI Insight Summit 2026, foreign brokerage heads said stronger corporate earnings, lower crude oil prices and a renewed growth advantage are key to reviving FPI inflows
